notes: net::http::pprof: Cmdline and the Index page and the Symbol/Handler request handling are byte-identical to Go (verified with tools/pprof_check.py); Go's runtime profiles (goroutine, heap, allocs, block, mutex, threadcreate, goroutineleak, CPU, execution trace, program-counter symbols) are views of the Go runtime and do not exist for Rust programs, so those endpoints are the deviation go-runtime-profiles. register_profile adds custom profiles (runtime/pprof.NewProfile) and register_default_handlers mounts the five endpoints on the default mux as importing Go's package does

Handler.note: serves profiles added with register_profile; Go's runtime profile names answer 404 Unknown profile

Index.note: the exact HTML page, listing cmdline, profile, symbol, trace and the registered profiles; Go's runtime profile rows are absent

Profile.note: answers as Go does when the CPU profiler cannot start: 500 Could not enable CPU profiling

Symbol.note: parses the same GET/POST counters and reports the same read errors, but resolves no function names (runtime.FuncForPC)

Trace.note: answers as Go does when tracing cannot start: 500 Could not enable tracing
